market_definition: The anaerobic adhesives market comprises single-component methacrylate-ester adhesives that cure in the absence of oxygen between close-fitting metal parts. It measures sales of threadlockers, retaining compounds, pipe sealants and gasketing products. BY PRODUCT FUNCTION: Threadlockers, Retaining Compounds, Thread & Pipe Sealants, Flange & Gasketing Sealants. BY STRENGTH: Low-Strength, Medium-Strength, High-Strength. BY PACKAGE SIZE: Small Bottles & Tubes, Cartridges & Bulk Containers. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Automotive & Transportation, Industrial Machinery & Equipment, Electronics & Electrical, Fluid Power & Plumbing, Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Cyanoacrylate and structural acrylic adhesives; non-curing thread sealants such as PTFE tape; silicone gaskets; mechanical fasteners. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
